verdict.rationale: Paychex documents offering comprehensive health insurance benefits. It also says benefits can be added in the same system as payroll without moving data, and lists a 'Benefit Administration: Recurring Deduction' API use case, which points to benefit deductions tied to payroll. All of this is thin marketing or use-case headings rather than documented benefits-administration workflows. missing for 10: documented employee enrollment flows (open enrollment, plan selection, life events), detail on how health-plan deductions sync into payroll automatically, ops-side plan administration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
